label: ext.blocktype ext.manifest
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.manifest

properties.capabilities: what the extension may render and which CCGW scopes its skills need
properties.category: distribution category: bundled ships with calliopa as open source, individual stays private to its instance; absent means individual, and the release export refuses anything not explicitly bundled
properties.dependencies: map of extension id to semver range, one entry per dependsOn relation; the range lives here because a relation stores no properties
properties.entrypoint: a source path within the extension's own subtree; absent when the extension ships no executable UI code
properties.id: the extension id; the manifest is the subtree root and its id names the extension

createParameters.semantics: The subtree root of an extension. Every member Block carries a partOf relation to its manifest; dependsOn relations connect manifest to manifest. Materializes to src/extensions/<extId>/manifest.json.
